description: Import up to 500 items, the same limit as the website. A plain import is free. enrich uses one market value check per enriched item, the same monthly allowance as get_market_value. If the allowance runs out, the rest are still imported without a market value, and the result says how many were left unenriched. The first call previews the import and returns a confirm token that holds only a hash of the rows. A second call resends the same rows with that token. Imported inventory, lent and wishlist items also get the top suggested product photo, one image suggestion each, for as many as this month's image suggestions and the time for one call allow. The result says how many in photos_attached and photos_left. The rest are imported with no photo, and fill_missing_images can add photos later.

confirm_token.description: Confirm token from the previous call. Without it, nothing is changed.

enrich.description: Look up a market value for each item, within this month's allowance
